response.justification: The candidate comfortably exceeds every technical requirement — strong TypeScript/Node.js, React, REST, databases, plus nice-to-haves like AWS, Kubernetes, and LLM/MCP agent tooling. However, this is an entry-level junior/mid role, and the candidate has roughly 15+ years of experience at senior and staff levels, creating a significant risk of overqualification, compensation mismatch, and short tenure. They are also currently employed, and their fit for an on-site junior IC position is questionable unless there is a deliberate reason for stepping down in seniority.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js fullstack experience with React, REST APIs, and relational databases
Covers most nice-to-haves: AWS (CDK), Kubernetes, Docker, and LLM/MCP agentic tooling
Proven mentorship, testing culture, and clean-architecture mindset (TDD, workshops, open source)
concerns: Heavily overqualified for an entry-level role — likely salary and retention mismatch
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience (MongoDB, MySQL, generic SQL instead)
Currently employed as a Staff Engineer; motivation for a junior on-site role is unclear

key_factors.factor: Strong technical stack match (TypeScript, React, AWS, K8s, LLMs)
